title: Ansel and the Terminal
author: Odile Oyelaran
blurb: Lena Eriksen, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
